description: This file defines the ArrayLoader class in the Twig templating engine, which loads templates from an internal array. It includes methods for setting, retrieving, checking existence, generating cache keys, and verifying freshness of templates, primarily used for unit testing.

classes.name: ArrayLoader
classes.description: A loader class that retrieves templates stored in an internal array, mainly used for testing purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayLoader with an optional array of templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets or updates a template in the internal array with a given name and source code.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source context for a named template, throws an error if the template is not found.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a template with the given name exists in the internal array.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for the template based on its name and content.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is considered fresh; always returns true in this implementation.
